universe: All authenticated pre-T30 frozen winner-product records linked by exact event/selection/offer IDs to saved direct official Betman DOM; Aug28-Nov3 2026, availability-driven, never old-policy ROI relabelled as current model ROI.
expert_inputs: first_observed pregame source-native pick text; non-baseline, ungraded, no-parlay, full-game explicit ML, author first vote, same author conflicting earliest votes held. Team/date/scheduled ET kickoff mapped uniquely; no retrospective graded events as features. Missing expert quoted odds is allowed for explicit ML text because evaluation prices come solely from frozen Proto offers; present American quote must be consistent.
timing: vote received <= frozen market/asof/capture cutoff and strictly before kickoff-T30, quote/capture beforeT30; no source publication claim substituted for actual first receipt.
moneyline_tie: vote tie abstains; common unique-vote cohort is primary for matched performance; all-fixture coverage reported separately.
raw_proof: Preserve source-native raw_text and metadata hashes; do not pretend a raw_text snapshot is complete HTML. Public HTML hash-only rows form a separate evidence tier if original bytes absent.
historical_claim_tier: Existing postgame-collected articles may be matched diagnostically only in a separate retrospective-source-claim tier; do not certify pregame availability or purchase-time prices.
pricing: Use each chosen side own original frozen option; never source-quoted or closing odds in primary comparison.
grading: Official full-game same product; exclude pending/void/ambiguous score units, validate row/file hashes and fixture+kickoff+offer identities.
stakes: 10000won equal single-stake diagnostic; no wallet/schedule/model changes; monthly -50000won paper ledger unchanged.
models_retained: Separate inventory of all preserved model families; do not substitute player-model historical test ROI for these fixtures.
